profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Q2
profile.summary: Seasoned Technical Lead with over 25 years of experience in the full software development lifecycle. A certified Scrum Master with exceptional analytical and creative skills.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led AI-driven innovations by developing and integrating advanced text processing tools, leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to enhance the AI's knowledge base and capabilities.
Led the deployment of these tools in Q2’s Configuration Management System, which serves over 500 internal and external financial users. These AI solutions significantly reduced call center support cases, boosting operational efficiency and user satisfaction.
Additionally, oversaw the strategic refactoring of critical project components, transitioning from JavaScript to TypeScript, upgrading Node, and optimizing system performance to ensure stability, testing, and quality assurance across the platform.

positions.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Led the architecture and development of a rack and server hardware test application for a cloud provider, utilizing micro-services and Kubernetes to optimize performance and scalability.
Implemented a comprehensive CI/CD setup for both back-end and front-end services, including automated testing, linting, compilation, docker image building, and Kubernetes deployment.
Introduced quality best practices to an existing development team, incorporating CI/CD automation for development and releases, code reviews, unit testing, automated integration testing, stress testing, and fault-injection testing.
Contributed to back-end and front-end development efforts, utilizing Angular v9, Java Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL to deliver high-quality software solutions.

positions.title: Engineering Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led the complete rewrite of a Windows desktop accounting application for restaurants, as well as the development of a feature-rich labor scheduler for restaurant managers. 
Utilized Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, to ensure effective project management and delivery. Spearheaded front-end development efforts using Angular, RxJS, Redux, HTML5, SCSS, and TypeScript, and created reusable Common UI elements to streamline development. 
Contributed to back-end development using Node.js and TypeScript for the accounting project, and .NET Web API for the scheduling application. Implemented micro-services architecture using Windows and Alpine Linux Docker containers, ensuring optimal scalability and performance

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed a C# MVC5 web application to manage inventory of electronic components, utilizing a well-defined RESTful API with WebAPI and AJAX on the client-side. Created dynamic SVG graphics using JavaScript and the Open Source framework RaphaelJS to enhance the user experience. Implemented real-time interfaces for placement machines using custom APIs to improve operational efficiency and accuracy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development and implementation of new functionalities into the Esurance Customers and Agents
Web Site.
• Technical design document creation based on business specifications.
• Development of new classes to support the Renters product into the Esurance current
workflow.
• Unit testing.
• Troubleshooting and defect fixing.

Technologies: .NET, SQL Server, TFS, jQuery

positions.title: Sr. Analyst - Apps Prog
positions.description:
Supported a software framework that offers an authorization layer for internal and external applications, with more than 40,000 users globally.
Managed redesign of several tools and modules that improved the security, usability and reduced the on-boarding time for new applications.
Worked with customers to plan and build realistic specifications based on their requirements.
Managed a team of off-shore developers.
Led various disaster recovery and release management strategies.

Technologies: .NET, SQL Server, TFS, jQuery

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.description: Provided level 2 and 3 regional support for various manufacturing systems at the Austin site, including PDM, Spears, and FlexFlow. Designed and implemented a Component Traceability System to record manufacturer information at the component level for each board built on the site. This system included an import/export module, real-time transmission module, and several automated maintenance tasks, and supported big data sets (>1 Terabyte). Successfully deployed this system at the Austin site and several other Flextronics' locations. Also designed a web application for internal audits, enabling managers to review and approve access, as well as a web application for requesting and purchasing internal repair materials.
